text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Potassium-sparing diuretics such as spironolactone can increase the risk of hyperkalemia when administered concomitantly with ACE inhibitors like lisinopril [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1]. ACE inhibitors are also recognized as drugs that can increase potassium levels when given alongside spironolactone, which may lead to severe hyperkalemia [spironolactone:drug_interactions:1]. Therefore, if concomitant use is indicated, serum potassium levels should be monitored frequently [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1].
